text.en: Every reviewer emphasizes the kindness and attentiveness of the veterinary staff at Tanglewilde. Practitioners like Dr. Frank and Dr. Parkerson receive glowing praise for listening closely to client concerns and treating pets like family. Techs and front desk associates are routinely complimented for their welcoming and organized service.

Clients highlight how patiently the team works with nervous, difficult, or vet-averse animals. Owners describe techs using positive reinforcement treats, gentle holding, and sedation when necessary for stress-free nail trims. Even dogs that previously feared veterinary visits are described as walking into the clinic happily without anxiety.

title.en: Prompt scheduling and short wait times

text.en: Pet owners consistently note that appointments run right on schedule with little to no waiting room delay. The clinic is also commended for accommodating sudden illnesses on short notice, with several clients reporting they were squeezed in within hours when their animals needed immediate care. Scheduling appointments is simple and prompt.

q.en: Can Tanglewilde Veterinary Clinic handle pets with high vet anxiety?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that the team uses gentle handling, treats, and light sedation when needed to make nail trims and exams stress-free.

q.en: How quickly can owners schedule an appointment?

a.en: Pet parents report that routine appointments are easy to book and that the clinic has accommodated urgent cases within a couple of hours.

q.en: Does the clinic care for exotic pets?

a.en: While the clinic primarily treats cats and dogs, reviewers mention bringing exotic shorthair cats and routine companion animals for regular medical exams.
